> A custom hardware Audio mixer that allows you to control the per-app volume through a physical slider. Teammates being too loud on discord? slide their volume to zero fast without having to press a a key combinaion to access the software per-app volume controller to change the volume that could waste precious seconds when in competitive play. 3 analog sliders connected to one ESP32 which communicates to a desktp app that links the slider to an app of your choosing (discord, gamechat, music, etc) an LED bar would provide feedback on slider positioin and volume. And after slider is moved, the led bar would switch to reactive mode which makes a bouncing motion depedning on the apps sound
